biggest_catch: The panel was rebranded to 'Unlock' in 2024 (per third-party sources) and no official site or terms page could be located through search — there is no obtainable official source stating the current payout terms, so the route cannot be verified and must not be presented as a confirmed way to make money.
catches: No official website or official rewards/terms page for Maru Springboard America (or its 'Unlock' successor) was returned by any search — only third-party review sites.
All concrete figures (50-500 points / $0.50-$5 per survey; 5,000 points = $50 redemption) come from third-party reviewers, not the company.
Third parties also report a high $50 redemption threshold and only 1-4 surveys per month, which would make progress extremely slow even if the panel still operates as described.
Rebrand to 'Unlock' in 2024 means the catalog's provider name/URL may be stale.

c3.evidence: Third-party sources describe membership as free; no official fee schedule obtainable.

c4.evidence: No official source obtained: repeated searches returned no official Maru/Unlock panel site or terms page, only third-party reviewers.

eligibility: Unknown from official sources. Third parties report US residency and age 14+ were required.
